'''Knife''' can refer to the following:

* ''[[Lord of Chaos/Chapter 48|Leaning on the Knife]]'' - the forty-eighth chapter of ''[[Lord of Chaos]]''.
* ''[[Knife of Dreams]]'' - the eleventh book in the ''[[Wheel of Time]]''.
* [[Marriage knife]] - a part of [[Ebou Dar]]i custom and fashion.
* [[The Marriage Knife]] - a small inn in [[Altara]].
* ''[[Sovin Nai]]'' - an [[Aiel warrior society]], meaning "Knife Hands" in the [[Old Tongue]].
